author: _Ben_Dover
body:
• My name is _Ben_Dover
  • I was banned for Excessive chat related infractions.
  • Before questions are asked, Pelpelajax informed me that i would be able to appeal this Ban in a later time. Just to recap, what had happened was i was permanently banned for to many chat related infractions. As i said in the first appeal, its not actually me causing this, it was my little brother who had access to my computer. I did not realise how serious it was getting, and then resolved in him causing me a permanent ban. To prevent this from happening again once i get unbanned, i have disabled any kind of access for my brother to get on here and use profanity and vulgarity, my computer has secure pass codes on everything, and i have also punished him for what he did. 1 week before this incident i had purchased the $50 Diamond rank which i was very excited to play on, but then to find myself extremely disappointed to lose all of that just for something i didn't do. I have waited long enough and Im sure Lewis has learnt his lesson, and i certainly have too... don't allow your siblings access to your computer ;) . I am very much looking forward to hopefully see you all again!
